description: This file defines an abstract class AbstractRestParser, which is part of the AWS SDK for PHP. It provides a framework for parsing REST API responses, including extracting payloads, headers, status codes, and handling various data types. The class is meant to be extended for specific REST API response parsing implementations.

classes.name: AbstractRestParser
classes.description: An abstract class for parsing REST API responses within the AWS SDK for PHP, handling payload extraction, header parsing, and response metadata.

methods.name: payload
methods.description: Abstract method to parse payload data from a response; to be implemented by subclasses.

methods.name: __invoke
methods.description: Parses a ResponseInterface object based on API output shape and populates the result array.

methods.name: extractPayload
methods.description: Extracts payload data from the response, handling streaming and structured data.

methods.name: extractHeader
methods.description: Extracts a single header value from the response and converts it based on its shape type.

methods.name: extractHeaders
methods.description: Extracts multiple headers with a common prefix into the result array.

methods.name: extractStatus
methods.description: Extracts the HTTP status code from the response and adds it to the result.
